words.def: the relationship between two people who are friends
to have a good relationship with someone
to share a lot of interests, ideas or experiences with someone
to have an argument and stop being friendly with someone
to continue to write, call or message someone you do not see often
to meet someone you have arranged to see, usually socially
to spend time with other people in a friendly way
to believe that someone is honest and will not hurt you
the activity of sharing information, news and feelings with other people
to join two things, people or ideas together
to come together again after a long time apart
television, radio, newspapers and the internet, seen as a group
a mobile phone that also works like a small computer
the state of belonging to a club, group or organization
the time when you are not working and can do what you enjoy
a group of people who work together to achieve something they believe in
to grow or change gradually into something stronger or more complete
a change that makes something better than it was

items: ✓ talk about your friendships — get on well with, have a lot in common, fall out with
✓ say how you stay in contact — keep in touch, meet up, socialize
✓ talk about what you usually do, using the present simple
✓ talk about what is happening right now and what is changing, using the present continuous
✓ talk about something that started in the past and is still true, using the present perfect
✓ ask How long have you known…? and answer with for and since recycled
